summary: Collector Crypt had its biggest week yet: Crypto Banter, citing Blockworks data, says weekly gross revenue on Solana hit nearly $80M. At the same time Pump.fun quietly moved its gacha packs from Collector Crypt to Phygitals, and PrizePicks launched card packs for mainstream sports bettors. Solflare Packs talk was steady but mostly from small accounts and Guardians; the biggest post was @Tukytuky_'s first rare pull, boosted by a pack giveaway. Retail pain stayed loud, with huge engagement on Walmart Prismatic Evolutions drawings and complaints about scalpers and falling modern card prices.

top_posts.text: COLLECTOR CRYPT JUST POSTED ITS BIGGEST WEEK EVER! @Blockworks data shows @Collector_Crypt weekly gross revenue on Solana spiked to nearly $80M, the highest since launch.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Our pack partner is at a record week, shared by a 441k-follower account (10.5k impressions). Good backdrop for Solflare Packs posts.

top_posts.text: PUMPFUN QUIETLY SWITCHED TCG PACKS FROM COLLECTOR CRYPT TO PHYGITALS! Pump.fun launched its TCG gacha packs on Collector Crypt, then moved them to Phygitals with no official announcement from either side.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Yesterday's Pump.fun switch is now in big crypto media. Solflare is one of the bigger Collector Crypt outlets left.

top_posts.text: MY FIRST RARE PULL ON @solflare PACKS. Had to celebrate with a giveaway. Giving away 1 Solflare Pack worth $50 to one of you. Like & RT & Drop your SOL wallet below
top_posts.why_it_matters: Biggest Solflare Packs post of the day (6.6k impressions), but engagement is mostly giveaway entries, not organic interest.

top_posts.text: Prismatic Evolutions Booster Bundle 2-Pack Drop Today at 2PM PT / 5PM ET! All Pokemon TCG Drawings... Free to join!
top_posts.why_it_matters: 399k impressions for a Walmart drawing alert. Collectors now enter lotteries just to buy packs at retail.

top_posts.text: If your buying cards for this much you need your head testing. Happened with 30th and ascended heroes. If you're paying over the odds for Pokemon chase cards before release "for grading" even so it's a massive no no.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Collectors are wary of overpaying for chase cards. A reminder to keep our copy away from value talk.

top_posts.text: Despite what people say about Pokemon still not printing enough, the evidence shows that they in fact are. All modern cards and sealed are down meaning that scalpers/investors aren't able to keep up or maintain their grasp/control of the market.
top_posts.why_it_matters: 10.7k impressions on the scalper and market mood. Mainstream collectors are tired of flippers.

top_posts.text: Trading cards are heating up on Robinhood Chain. @pulldotfun is selling packs of PSA 9/10 Pokemon and Riftbound cards. Every card is vaulted, so collectors are shipping their hits home, selling them back or listing them the same day.
top_posts.why_it_matters: pull.fun on Robinhood Chain uses the same keep, sell back or ship pitch as us.

top_posts.text: How cool is this card?? Newgate, "Whitebeard", the One Piece treasure rare, for sure one of the best card I pulled myself... Do you like it? Do you think I should sell it?
top_posts.why_it_matters: 'Keep or sell?' pull posts get lots of replies. Fits our keep, sell back or ship choice.

top_posts.text: Pokémon TCG Pocket: The Second Anniversary Celebration Campaign starts on October 30 and runs until December 15. Players will receive a ticket that can be exchanged for a booster pack containing a guaranteed 2-star card!
top_posts.why_it_matters: Mainstream digital pack opening is big (53k impressions). TCG Pocket players are a natural audience for in-app pack rips.

top_posts.text: FBI and Santa Ana police are now investigating the Oct. 13 theft of 6,451 graded items, nearly 3,000 Pokémon cards, worth $963K from a FedEx truck near PSA's grading center. PSA deactivated their certs to block resale.
top_posts.why_it_matters: Shipping cards to grade is risky. Our cards are already graded and vaulted.

sources_note: X search via the x connector, posts from 2026-10-26 09:00 UTC to 2026-10-27 09:05 UTC, 7 searches. Engagement numbers are copied from the X API at scan time. The top Solflare Packs post (@Tukytuky_) is a giveaway, so its engagement is mostly entries. Most other Solflare Packs posts come from small accounts with low impressions, so read volume as campaign activity, not organic demand. Collector Crypt revenue and Pump.fun switch are third-party reports, not confirmed by the companies in this scan. PrizePicks Packs details come from an affiliate post. Spam, giveaway reply farms and token shill posts were skipped. Creators already in collector-base.csv or in yesterday's file were excluded.
